data.title: Add 'docket context' command for agent automation
data.body:
Dump a change plus all ancestors' scratchpads for full context.

When working on a deeply nested change, an agent needs to understand the full context chain:
- Parent scratchpad: overall approach decisions
- Child scratchpad: specific implementation decisions  
- Grandchild scratchpad: detailed notes

This command would output the change details plus concatenated scratchpads from all ancestors, giving agents complete context for their work.
